Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_BiiTooltip: Better Item Info: keep other mods' tooltip rows
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_BiiTooltip_too: With Guns of Marz active, Better Item Info resets the item tooltip when a world starts, which hides the rows other mods add, such as backpack upgrades, seed seasons and silencer durability. This keeps them. Only active with Better Item Info and Guns of Marz.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_BpHotbar: Better Pause: hotbar keys while paused, with SwapIt
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_BpHotbar_toolt: Better Pause lets the hotbar keys work while the game is paused, but SwapIt puts vanilla's pause check back. This lets them work while paused again. Only active with Better Pause and SwapIt.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_CleanUIBlink_t: The vanilla tutorial makes a container button blink, but CleanUI's inventory window has no way to do that and the tutorial raises an error. This adds it to CleanUI's window. Only active with CleanUI.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_FhKeys: Fancy Handwork: swap-hands keys work and stop throwing errors
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_FhKeys_tooltip: On 42.22 the Fancy Handwork B42.19 build throws an error on every key press and its swap-hands keys do nothing. This replaces its key handler with a working one. Only active with that build of Fancy Handwork.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_GydeHandy: Trait Magazines: Handy magazine skill levels
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_GydeHandy_tool: With Gyde's Trait Magazines and its Extended add-on both active, reading the Handy magazine gives the trait but not the four skill levels Extended adds. This lets Extended handle that magazine, as it intends.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_HotbarEquip_to: SwapIt replaces the hotbar's equip step, which turns off Fancy Handwork's modifier + hotbar key (take into the off hand) and H_E_C_U's hotbar key on helmets and masks (put on or take off). This brings both back on top of SwapIt. Only active with SwapIt and at least one of the two.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_P4Place: Picking Meister: Grab Contents next to Place
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_P4Place_toolti: Better Item Transfer renames Place Item to Place, so Picking Meister's Grab and Unpack Contents entry moves to the bottom of the menu or is not offered. This puts it back beside Drop and Place. Only active with both mods.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_SeatView: Clear Driver View Fix: no seat diagram flash with KI5's seat UI
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_SeatView_toolt: KI5's seat UI replaces the seat diagram's drawing and drops Clear Driver View Fix's guard, so the diagram can flash when you start driving. This keeps it hidden while you drive with the engine on. Only active with both mods.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_SgKills: Super Gore: zombies it finishes count as kills
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_SgKills_toolti: Super Gore settles a hit a moment later, and a zombie it kills that way (a severed head, a burst chest) is not added to your zombie kill count. This adds it, in single player and multiplayer. Only active with Super Gore.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_SgTank: Super Gore: the Tank takes hits by its own rules
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_SgTank_tooltip: Super Gore and the Special Zombies Tank both hold back a hit's damage, and together a Tank dies to almost any weapon hit, or gains health when a limb is cut. This leaves Tanks to their own mod, without Super Gore's gore. Other zombies are unchanged. Only active with both mods.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_SlingStop: Weapon Sling: no ghost weapon after a cancelled attach
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_SlingStop_tool: Cancelling a hotbar attach halfway (for example by running) can leave the weapon model hanging on the body without it being on the hotbar. This takes the model off again, as vanilla does. Only active with Weapon Sling.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_TileProps: Vanilla tile properties under tile mods
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_TileProps_tool: More Damaged Objects and Raven Creek replace whole vanilla tilesets with older copies, so some street lights stop lighting, hedges cannot be picked up, ladders, fences and signs lose properties, and town signs lose their two-tile pickup. This puts every lost vanilla property back when the tiles load, and keeps what those mods add.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_UsDrops: Undead Survivor: corpse loot in multiplayer is the server's only
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_UsDrops_toolti: In multiplayer, Undead Survivor's outfit zombies get extra random loot on every client, which shows in the corpse but cannot be taken until the corpse is moved. This leaves the loot to the server, so a corpse shows what can really be looted. Only active with Undead Survivor.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_UsItems: Undead Survivor: gas masks keep after a filter change, Stalker knife sharpens
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_UsItems_toolti: Undead Survivor's three gas masks are deleted once their filter is removed, and its Stalker knife cannot be sharpened. This makes the masks stay like vanilla gas masks and lets the sharpening recipes take the knife. Only active with Undead Survivor.
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_VehicleLoot: SpecLoot: loot in burnt wrecks and Ford F450 trucks
Sandbox_LugliModpackFixes_VehicleLoot_to: SpecLoot's rewritten loot files leave six burnt wrecks and seven Ford F350/F450 work trucks with empty containers. This gives the wrecks their live vehicle's loot, as their own mods do, and the work trucks vanilla work, mechanic, construction or ambulance loot. Only active with SpecLoot.
